## Security and supply-chain checklist
- [ ] No passwords, API keys, tokens, private keys, keystores, recovery codes, or other secrets were committed.
- [ ] Dependency changes were reviewed and Dependency Review is not failing.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes preserve authentication, authorization, TLS, signing, and least-privilege controls.
- [ ] Generated artifacts are traceable to the exact source SHA.
- [ ] I did not weaken or bypass a failing security control merely to make CI pass.

## Merge gate
- [ ] Required exact-head checks are terminal and successful.
- [ ] The PR has the required review/approval.
- [ ] Merge is explicitly authorized by the repository owner.
